## Description {#details}

<p>C++ header file with the inline implementations for the µOS++ lists methods.</p>


<p>The <span class="doxyComputerOutput">inlines.h</span> header provides the C++ inline implementations for the <b>µOS++ Intrusive Lists</b> classes.</p>


<p>Class definitions are located in <a href="/utils-lists-xpack/docs/api/files/include/micro-os-plus/utils/lists-h">lists.h</a>. Inline methods are separated into this file to improve project structure and maintainability.</p>
